name: liana-p/narrat-engine
description: Narrat is a TypeScript/Vue game engine for building interactive narrative RPGs with skill checks, inventory, quests, and a scripting syntax for branching dialogue and story flow.
score_rationale: A dedicated narrative RPG engine with a complete feature set, though modest community size at 177 stars; a solid niche tool for browser-based narrative games.
summary: TypeScript/Vue narrative RPG engine with inventory and dialogue systems
